meta.note: English for the engine’s built-in interface text. Keys are the Traditional Chinese source strings.

strings.<div class=\"endpic\" id=\"endPic\"><img: Making card
strings.<span class=\"g-h\">按「帶我去」會自己走過去。想自己走：: <span class="g-h">Press "Take me there" to walk there automatically. To steer yourself:
strings.{0}在忙，朝你點了一下頭。: {0} is busy and gives you a nod.
strings.。頭上有「！」的就是要找的對象。</span>: . The "!" marks who or what you are looking for.
strings.在圖上按右鍵可以另存，或按這裡: Right-click the image to save it, or
strings.存好之後，打開社群 App 的限時動態，選這張圖就能發。如果沒有反應，長按上面的: Once it's saved, open the story feature in your social app and pick this image to post it. If nothing happens, press and hold the image above to save it.
strings.存好了。貼到哪裡都可以。: Saved. Post it anywhere you like.
strings.方向鍵、WASD，或點地板: use the arrow keys or WASD, or click the floor
strings.有虛線的詞可以點，會跳出白話解釋。: Tap a word with a dotted underline for a plain-English explanation.
strings.用左下的方向鍵，或點地板: use the arrow buttons at the lower left, or tap the floor
strings.畫面上方會告訴你下一步。跟著頭上有「！」的人走，或按「帶我去」。: The top of the screen tells you what to do next. Walk to whoever has a “!” over their head, or press “Take me there”.
strings.聲音：開。按一下關掉: Sound: on. Press to turn off
strings.聲音：關。按一下打開: Sound: off. Press to turn on
strings.複製不了，請直接複製網址列: Could not copy. Copy the address bar instead.
strings.走動：方向鍵、WASD 或點地板 對話：走近按 E: Walk: arrow keys, WASD or click the floor.  Talk: walk close and press E.
strings.這台裝置開不了 3D 場景。遊戲內容照常可以玩。: This device can't open the 3D scene. You can still play the game as usual.
strings.遊戲裡現在的時間: The time in the game right now
strings.長按圖片存到相簿，就能發限時動態。: Press and hold the image to save it, then post it as a story.
strings.長按圖片，選「儲存」或「分享」，再到限時動態選它。: Press and hold the image, choose Save or Share, then pick it for your story.
